CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Telnet port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Telnet port (TCP: 23).
Risk: This legacy port handles unencrypted terminal sessions. Attackers can sniff login credentials in transit, execute arbitrary commands on network devices/servers, or intercept sensitive configuration data during administration.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
